## 2

I understand why some images can look edited or distant from everyday experience, but the evidence for a round Earth does not depend on a single photograph. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth casts a round shadow during lunar eclipses, and time zones follow naturally from a rotating globe. Satellites, GPS, flight routes, and observations made independently by many countries also rely on the same model. Those lines of evidence would be extraordinarily difficult to fake consistently.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is really a mixture of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny gas molecules. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than red light because blue has shorter waves. So blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky, making the whole sky look blue. At sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, and much of the blue gets scattered away before the light reaches us. The remaining reds and oranges create those warm sunset colors.

## 4

雨下了一整夜，城市像被一层透明的帘子隔开。路灯的光落在湿漉漉的地面上，碎成一片片摇晃的金色。屋檐不断滴水，声音清脆而单调，像有人在远处轻敲玻璃。窗外偶尔驶过一辆车，轮胎划开积水，留下短暂的白色浪花。房间里很安静，只有雨声贴着窗沿流淌。热茶的雾气慢慢升起，我靠在椅背上，看着夜色被雨水洗得朦胧而柔软。
